description: The account's address and the unsigned PayAccountFactory.open(owner, salt) transaction, or with eth, openWithETH: the ETH is swapped to USDG on the way in (WETH/USDG pool), at least minUsdg or it reverts (minUsdg defaults to Chainlink's ETH price less 1%; the factory itself refuses below Chainlink less 2%, and while that price is older than 48 hours). Anyone can send it; the account is the owner's. salt is zero when left out: one account per owner.

eth.description: Optional: ETH to put in, swapped to USDG, like "0.01".

from.description: Optional: the wallet that sends it; the owner when left out.

minUsdg.description: Optional with eth: the least USDG the swap may give.

owner.description: The agent's wallet that will own the pay account.

salt.description: Optional: 32 bytes; zero when left out.

name: pay_account_open_transaction
title: Mercatura Pay: open a pay account
